source.title: Four years of operational data for five hydrogen refueling stations

reported_aggregate.source_scope_note: The title refers to five stations; the abstract describes four HRS in the 3Emotion project and an operator-log dataset covering three years.

claim_boundary: This open-access article reports operator-log aggregates for a 350 bar fuel-cell-bus station cohort. It does not release synchronized raw station, dispenser and vehicle rows with channel definitions, calibration uncertainty or reuse permission, and the title/abstract describe different station and time scopes. Values are contextual aggregates only.
